turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, is that Chloe? It's Jack calling from Acme Life. You filled in a call-back request on our website last night about our life cover.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes, that's me. Look, I've got about ten minutes before I need to be back on the shop floor, so can we keep it quick?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Absolutely, I'll keep it tight. So I've got your form here. You've put down that you're 38, non-smoker, and you were after a quote for around $500,000 of cover. I've already run that through and it comes out at $62.40 a month to start with.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Right, okay. Sixty-two a month. That's not too bad. Is that it then, can I just lock that in?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: We can definitely look at that, but before I suggest whether $500,000 is the right figure, can I ask a few quick questions about your situation? What's prompting you to look at cover now?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Honestly, I run a small florist in Brunswick, I've got a business loan, and my partner and I just bought a place. My accountant keeps nagging me that if something happened to me, everything falls apart.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That makes sense. Roughly how much is the mortgage, and is the business loan in your name personally?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Mortgage is about $410,000. Business loan's around $60,000, and yeah, I'm the guarantor on it.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: And any kids or anyone else relying on your income?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: One little one, she's three. Can we speed this up a bit though? What do I actually get?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Sure. So Acme Life Cover pays a lump sum if you pass away. You can pick anywhere from $50,000 up to $1,000,000. Given the mortgage and the loan you've mentioned, $500,000 would roughly cover those debts, though it wouldn't leave a lot extra for your daughter. Some people in a similar spot look a bit higher. I should say that's general information only, it doesn't take into account your full personal circumstances or finances, so you'd want to weigh it up against your own situation.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Okay. And do I need to go and get blood tests or anything? Because I genuinely don't have time for that.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No medical exam. It's just a handful of health questions, and whether you're accepted depends on your answers to those.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Good. So if I sign up today I'm covered from today?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: This is an important one. In the first 12 months, only accidental death is covered. So if you passed away from an illness in that first year, the policy wouldn't pay out. After the 12 months, you're covered for death from any cause, subject to the policy terms.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Hm. So for a whole year it's basically just accident cover.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: For death, yes, that's right. Accidental death only for the first 12 months.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: And the sixty-two dollars, that stays the same?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No, and I want to be upfront about that. The premiums are stepped, so they go up each year as you get older. $62.40 a month is what you'd pay now at 38, but it'll increase at each renewal.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: By how much?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: It depends on your age each year, so it's a gradual increase rather than a set amount. I can email you the policy documents, which include the premium details, so you can see how it's worked out.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Right. That's the bit that worries me. I'm trying to budget the business for the next few years and I don't love something that creeps up.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's a fair concern. It's worth thinking about what you'd be comfortable paying down the track, not just now.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: And if I sign up and then change my mind?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: There's a 30-day cooling-off period. If you cancel within that time, you get a full refund of what you've paid.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Okay. Look, part of me wants to just say yes so it's done. But my accountant also said something about cover through my super, and I haven't even checked that.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's definitely worth checking. A lot of people have some cover in their super and don't realise it. It'd make sense to know what you've already got before deciding on an amount.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: So you're not going to tell me the price goes up if I don't sign today?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No, nothing like that. The quote's based on your age and answers, so take the time you need. There's no pressure to decide on this call.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Great. Then I think I'll hold off. I want to look at the super thing and talk to my partner about whether it should be more than five hundred.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Completely understandable. Would you like me to email the quote and the policy documents to the address on your form?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes, the Gmail one. That's fine.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Done, that'll be with you shortly. It'll have the $500,000 quote at $62.40 a month, plus the details on the stepped premiums and the 12-month accidental death period. If you'd like a different amount quoted, say $700,000, just reply or give us a call.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Okay. Do you need to call me back or will I just get in touch?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Whatever suits you. I'm happy to leave it with you, or I can give you a ring in a week or two if that's easier.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Let me get in touch. I'll be honest, my weeks are chaos.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No worries at all. You've got my name, Jack, and the number's in the email. Good luck with the shop today.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Thanks, Jack. Appreciate you not pushing. Bye.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Cheers, Chloe. Bye now.
